steps.text: This template verifies provenance claims off-chain with a deterministic agent swarm, then anchors receipts on Hedera. No Hedera account is needed for the offline demo.

steps.label: Copy the env file
steps.text: packages/nextjs/.env.example → packages/nextjs/.env, then add your Hedera testnet account

steps.label: Verify a claim end-to-end
steps.text: Submit the fixture coffee shipment in the UI and inspect the receipt, the HCS anchor, and the certificate NFT on HashScan.

description: Verifiable supply-chain provenance: a deterministic agent swarm checks a product's origin attestation, custody chain, and document hashes, then anchors the tamper-evident receipt on Hedera (smart-contract registry + HCS) and mints a provenance-certificate NFT.
name: provenance-swarm
